hook: The best open image model now comes from Ant Group.

beats.say: Ant Group's Ant Ling team introduced Ming Image zero point two Design, a model for UI drafts, posters and text heavy designs.
It ranks number one among open weight models on Artificial Analysis's text to image leaderboard, with an Elo score of one thousand ninety five.
The team open sourced the Design model now, and plans to open source the Layer model next week, which splits flat images into editable layers.
